description: Block private networks and cloud metadata endpoints. Allow internet.

notes.rfc1918: 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16 — prevents access to host and LAN
notes.link_local: 169.254.0.0/16 — full IPv4 link-local range (covers AWS/GCP IMDS at 169.254.169.254 and non-standard endpoints)
notes.ipv6_ula: fc00::/7 — IPv6 Unique Local Addresses (private equivalent)
